name: ViT: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words (arXiv:2010.11929)
notes: ICLR 2021. The foundational Vision Transformer paper. Table 6 reports FLOPs for ViT variants: ViT-L/16 at 224x224 = 190.7 GFLOPs, ViT-H/14 at 224x224 = 493.5 GFLOPs. These are the canonical reference numbers for vision encoder inference cost.
